messages:
Lina (Partnerships): Firmament PO is stuck in the marketplace onboarding — vendor uploaded a signed PO but the billing entity is 'Firmament Inc' while procurement expects 'Firmament US LLC'. Procurement rejected it. Can we accept an alias mapping temporarily so integration can ship next week? @Mike L. any quick legal take?
Mike L. (Legal): Short answer: we can't change legal entity on a PO without an executed amendment. Quick workaround is an addendum that references both entity names + an explicit alias clause and signature. I can draft a minimal addendum. Need procurement signoff on temporary mapping though. :eyes:
marketplace-bot: ingestion status -> REJECTED: vendor_entity_mismatch.
```json
{"ticket_id":"MP-98721","vendor":"Firmament","received_entity":"Firmament Inc","expected_entity":"Firmament US LLC","reason":"entity_mismatch"}
```
Olivia - Ops: If vendor accepts the addendum e-sign, the portal will accept the PO. We can fast-track intake review once procurement uploads the signed addendum to the ticket. @Lina can you ask the CSM to get e-sign?
Lina (Partnerships): pinged Firmament CSM — they sent back a scanned PDF but the signatory table still lists the wrong legal name. They say their finance ops are remote this week. Attached snippet: "Signed by: J. Park, Firmament Inc". :pray:
Carlos (Finance): FYI PO also missing account code and billing GL. I can't map payments without the billing entity. If Legal signs off on alias, I can temporarily map account code `PRT-ALIAS-001` to allow a soft approve while we get the addendum. Otherwise payment hold.
Avery (Sales): We have a joint announcement scheduled next week and need it live. Can Partnerships escalate to the vendor AE / channel lead for priority? Sales needs a 48-hour SLA to avoid delaying the announcement.
Mike L. (Legal): I'll draft the addendum now and post it to the ticket. Minimal language: alias clause + warranty that signatory has authority. If they e-sign within 24h, I approve temporary acceptance. If they balk, we escalate to procurement legal for formal MSA amendment.
Lina (Partnerships): Thanks. Uploading draft to MP-98721 and asking CSM to push AE. If we don't have e-sign by EOD tomorrow I will escalate to Partnerships leadership and ask Sales to delay announcement.
Firmament CSM: On it — pushing to vendor finance, flagged as high priority with their FP&A. Will report back within 6 hours.
Mike L. (Legal): Added comment with redline and instructions for e-sign (DocuSign preferred). Carlos, please confirm you can run the temporary mapping once we have the signed addendum.
Carlos (Finance): Confirmed — I can run temporary mapping `PRT-ALIAS-001` for 7 days once addendum is attached to the marketplace ticket. After that we need full legal entity docs.
Lina (Partnerships): Great — action items: 1) Mike to post addendum redline, 2) Firmament CSM to get e-sign, 3) Carlos will map on receipt. I'll keep the thread updated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
